title: Need
description:
One thing an app requires, such as a secret it reads or the address of
another app it calls. Its path is `/jumpgate/needs/<app>/<name>`.

The record has no capability shape yet. The design gives a capability
need a shape, and no reader in the first version produces a capability
need, so the field waits for the reader that does.

app.description: The app that has the need.

consumers.description:
The units of the app that receive the need. Every need has at least
one, because a need that no unit receives has nothing to deliver to.

items.description: Names a unit: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter or a digit.

declared_in.description: The repository and file that declare the need.

file.description:
The file within the repository, relative to its root. It has at
most 1024 bytes, which maxLength cannot check for text outside ASCII
because it counts characters.

delivers_as.description: The variables or the file the need is delivered as.

oneOf.description: One or more environment variables, each of which receives the value.

items.description: Names an environment variable: ASCII letters, digits and '_', not starting with a digit, at most 128 bytes.

oneOf.description: A file whose content is the value.

file.description: Names the file a need is delivered as, absolute or relative to the unit's working directory; no segment is empty, '.' or '..', and none holds a '\' or a control character. The path has at most 1024 bytes, which maxLength cannot check for text outside ASCII because it counts characters.

name.description: The need's name within its app.

optional.description:
Whether the app runs without the need, as its declaration says. It
agrees with `when_unbound`, which is what the matcher acts on.

requests.description:
What the declaration asks for, so the matcher can match from records
alone: the repository and provide that a want names, or the offer
that a starmap bind derives. Absent when the declaration asks for
nothing in particular.

oneOf.description:
The need comes from a want: the offer of the named repository with
the named provide.

want.description: The repository and the name it provides, which a want asks for.

repo.description: The repository that provides the offer.

oneOf.description:
The need is a secret whose starmap entry has a bind: the offer that
the reader derived from the bind.

when.description:
The profiles or targets for which the app has the need; empty means
always.

items.description: A profile or a target for which an app has a need.

oneOf.description: The app has the need when it runs in this profile.

profile.description: Names a profile: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter or a digit.

oneOf.description: The app has the need when it runs on this target.

target.description: Names a target: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter or a digit.

when_unbound.description:
What happens when nothing binds the need. This field, and not
`optional`, governs matching: the matcher fails, omits or falls back
as it says. It agrees with `optional`, a rule across fields that
this schema does not express: an optional need never fails when
unbound, and a required need is never omitted. Either may fall back.

oneOf.description: The plan lists the need as unbound, and the units that need it fail.
The plan leaves the need out, and the app runs without it.

On a local target the need receives this value, and the plan says
so. The plan checks refuse a cloud plan in which a need is met by its
fallback.

fallback.description: The value a need receives on a local target when nothing binds it. It is a placeholder and never a real secret. It holds no NUL character and has at most 4096 bytes, which maxLength cannot check for text outside ASCII because it counts characters.
